```{python}
#| label: setup
import json, pathlib
import pandas as pd
R = json.loads(pathlib.Path("analysis/results.json").read_text())
A, RF = R["paper_a"], R["roles_final"]
SC = RF["tarama"]
COV = RF["kovaryans"]
KM = RF["K"]; KA = 5 if KM == 4 else 4                      # ana ve alternatif rol sayısı (karar kuralından)
WORD = {4: "four", 5: "five", 6: "six", 7: "seven"}
KW, KAW = WORD[KM], WORD[KA]
_names = lambda k: json.loads(pathlib.Path("analysis/" + ("role_names.json" if k == 5 else f"role_names_K{k}.json")).read_text())
ROLE, ROLEA = _names(KM), _names(KA)
FM, FA = RF["nihai"][f"K{KM}"], RF["nihai"][f"K{KA}"]
MM, MA = R[f"lineup_model_roles_final_K{KM}"], R[f"lineup_model_roles_final_K{KA}"]
MT = R["lineup_model_thesis_archetypes"]
DM, DA = MM["ayristirma"], MA["ayristirma"]
LK = MM["sizinti_denetimi"]
F0T, F2T = R["formula_test_corrected_min0_tezarketip"], R["formula_test_corrected_min2_tezarketip"]
n = lambda x: f"{x:,}"
pct = lambda x, d=0: f"{100 * x:.{d}f}%"
f2 = lambda x: f"{x:.2f}"
f3 = lambda x: f"{x:.3f}"
pp3 = lambda x: f"{100 * x:.3f}"
def fp(p):
    return "< .001" if p < 0.001 else f"= {p:.3f}".replace("0.", ".")
rid = {v: k for k, v in ROLE.items()}                         # rol adı → etiket
def share(role_name, pos, F=None, names=None):
    F, names = (F or FM), (names or ROLE)
    k = {v: kk for kk, v in names.items()}[role_name]
    t = F["pozisyon"][k]
    return t.get(pos, 0) / sum(t.values())
JM = FM["jaccard_kume"]
stable_roles = sum(j >= 0.75 for j in JM)
weakest = min(range(len(JM)), key=lambda i: JM[i]) + 1
P = MM["guc"]
pair = " × ".join(ROLE[str(i)].lower() for i in P["cift"])
def _term(t):
    a = t.replace("n", "").split("×")
    return " + ".join(ROLE[x].lower() for x in a) if len(a) == 2 else ROLE[a[0]].lower() + " count"
_pos = [(t, v) for t, v in MM["rol_bilesimi"]["en_buyuk_katsayilar"].items() if v > 0 and "×" in t][:3]
TOP = "; ".join(f"{_term(t)} ({v:+.2f})" for t, v in _pos)
```

# Abstract {.unnumbered}

```{python}
#| output: asis
print(f"**Purpose:** Data-driven player roles are increasingly used to describe positionless basketball and to guide lineup construction, but the stability of such roles and their value for explaining lineup performance beyond player quality are rarely tested. "
f"**Methods:** All EuroLeague games from 2016–17 to 2024–25 ({n(A['games'])} games) were analysed using official box scores, play-by-play, shot coordinates and assist links. "
f"Role variables (possession shares with on-court denominators, shot profile and assist-network indicators) were clustered with Gaussian mixture models in {n(RF['fit_N'])} player-seasons; the number of roles was chosen by player-level bootstrap stability. "
f"Role composition was tested against lineup net rating out of time (training 2016–2022, test 2023–2024), with regularised adjusted plus-minus (RAPM) controlling for player quality, a role-label permutation test, leakage checks and a power simulation. "
f"**Results:** Four roles were retained (mean bootstrap Jaccard {f2(FM['jaccard_ort'])}); a five-role solution was nearly as stable ({f2(FA['jaccard_ort'])}), whereas six or more roles were unstable, as was a previously used seven-cluster solution ({f2(A['thesis_ward7_jaccard_mean'])}). "
f"Ball handlers and rim protectors were {pct(share('Ball handler', 'Guard'))} guards and {pct(share('Rim protector', 'Center'))} centres, whereas interior bigs combined centres and forwards (Cramér's V = {f2(FM['cramers_v'])}). "
f"With roles estimated in each season, role counts improved out-of-time prediction beyond RAPM (permutation p {fp(DM['sayilar_p'])}), but not when test-season roles were restricted to information available in training (p {fp(LK['onceki_rol']['sayilar_p'])}). "
f"Pairwise role terms added no detectable information, but power to detect synergies of up to 1 point per 100 possessions was at most {pct(max(P['guc'].values()))}. "
f"**Conclusions:** Four to five functional roles can be recovered reproducibly from open EuroLeague data and are useful for describing players. There was no robust evidence that role composition adds to lineup performance beyond individual player quality, and small synergies could be neither detected nor excluded.")
```

# Prior dissemination {.unnumbered}

The data source and part of the analytic approach were first used in the author's doctoral thesis (Ege University, Türkiye), which is available through the national thesis repository; the thesis's role-clustering and lineup-optimisation results are re-examined, and in part corrected, here. The full thesis reference will be added before submission. A companion manuscript on the same data addresses a different question (the predictive validity of box-score value indices and lineup optimisation).

# Data and code availability {.unnumbered}

All data were obtained from the publicly accessible EuroLeague application programming interface. The code that downloads the data and reproduces every number, table and figure is available at https://github.com/koksalahmet85-svg/sports-science-paper-engine and will be archived with a persistent identifier before submission; the exact code version, random seed and package versions used are recorded in the results file (`provenance`).

# Use of artificial intelligence {.unnumbered}

A generative AI assistant (Claude, Anthropic) was used to assist with literature search, programming and language editing. All numerical results were produced by deterministic, version-controlled code; all sources, analyses and interpretations were verified by the author, who takes full responsibility for the content.
